audit.whatIsWrong: EVEN / 5.5 is right at 48.31% over 799 games, but the page never named the one number the whole lane runs on, and three full-layer level rows disagreed with the content layer (rows 0, 1 and 4).
audit.why: Orianna's Q reaches 815. Annie's longest DAMAGING range is 625 (Disintegrate); Incinerate is 600 and Summon: Tibbers is 600. She has no dash. The entire matchup is her needing to walk roughly 200 units into your ball to do anything, and level 6 being the one window where a charged Pyromania pays for that walk.
audit.corrected: Full sides moved to Orianna/Orianna/Skill/Skill/Annie/Skill/Orianna to match the packet and the content layer, with phases[4].why rewritten to Annie's verdict.
sources: brief.enemyKit Q range 625, W range 600, R range 600

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes was the generic Orianna template — 'level 6 doubles your lane presence; Luden's makes Q-W a third of a health bar'. Level 6 is Annie's, and the one-third figure has no source.
audit.why: Summon: Tibbers is 130/115/100s. That is the longest cooldown either champion has — longer than your own 110s Shockwave — so the spike map is: levels 1-2 yours on range, 6 hers on a charged Tibbers, two items yours because she has to walk 600 to start a fight.
audit.corrected: Levels 1-2 are yours on 815 range; 6 is hers on a charged Tibbers; two items is yours in every teamfight.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly told the reader Annie cannot threaten a stun early — whys[0] 'before she can threaten a stun', whys[1] 'while her passive is still building', content.early 'she can't threaten a real stun combo yet'.
audit.why: Riot's text for Pyromania ends with a sentence the page ignored: 'Annie begins the game and respawns with Pyromania available.' She has a stun charged from the first second of the game and again on every respawn. A player told otherwise walks into a level 1 stun.
audit.corrected: Level 1 is still Orianna's, but on RANGE (815 vs 625), not on the absence of a stun. Rewritten in whys[0], whys[1], content.early, breakdown.early and tldr.

audit.whatIsWrong: Pyromania was described only as vague 'stacks' — 'watch the glow under her feet', 'if her passive is at 3-4 stacks' — and the actual charge condition was never stated.
audit.why: It is four spell CASTS, then the next offensive spell stuns. That is countable in lane; 'stacks' and 'the glow' are not something a reader can plan around.
audit.corrected: Count her casts — four, and the fifth stuns. Stated in winCon, loading, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two content fields called her Q 'Disintegration'.
audit.why: The ability is Disintegrate. Same class of error as 'Noxious Blight' for Cassiopeia in the calibration list.
audit.corrected: Disintegrate, in content.early and content spikes[0].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer called Annie 'he/his' throughout — 'His combo beats yours', 'his farm path', 'his engage', 'a frozen wave at his tower', 'Trade while his full combo is loaded'.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists annie as female, and the content layer already used she/her, so the two panels of the same page disagreed.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to she/her across tldr, winCon, tradeGood, tradeBad, phases[0-3].why, breakdown.wave, dosFull, dontsFull and report[].

audit.why: The two numbers that matter are Summon: Tibbers at 130/115/100s — the longest cooldown in the matchup — and Disintegrate at 4s flat, which is why her poke is not the thing you wait out; her ult is.
audit.corrected: Tibbers 130/115/100s at 600, Pyromania's four casts, Command: Protect 9s.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string pasted under 'Punish his cooldown gap with full Q-W-auto'; dontsFull[2].d was the tradeBad string pasted under 'Burn R defensively when E already answers'; dontsFull[0].d read 'That is Annie's rehearsed moment — don't audition for it', which names nothing.
audit.why: Copy-paste bleed plus filler on three of six bullets.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to their own titles around the 130s Tibbers window, the 9s shield versus the 110s ultimate, and the charged-stun rotation.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization ended 'Zhonya's vs dive — buy the stopwatch the moment Zed hits 6'.
audit.why: Zed is not in this matchup — a leaked line. Zhonya's is genuinely correct here, but against a stunned Tibbers combo, which is what the line should say.
audit.corrected: Zhonya's vs her all-in — the stopwatch answers a stunned Tibbers combo.

notes: Level chart: three full-layer rows disagreed with the content layer and the packet — phases[0] and phases[1] read 'Skill' against 'Orianna', phases[4] read 'Skill' against 'Annie'. Packet and content agree exactly, so the full layer was moved to them; phases[0/1].why already described Orianna winning and needed only the pronoun fix, and phases[4].why was rewritten from 'Shockwave online — your lane presence doubles' to Annie's verdict. Content win[0..6] needs no edit. phases[N].rating was deliberately NOT touched — see questionsForUser. The most important correction is a factual one repeated in three places: the page said Annie cannot threaten a stun in the first levels, but Riot's own Pyromania text says 'Annie begins the game and respawns with Pyromania available' — she is charged from second zero and after every death. Level 1 still belongs to Orianna, but because of the 815-versus-625 range gap, not because the stun is absent. Also corrected: her Q is Disintegrate, not 'Disintegration' (two content fields), and Pyromania charges on four CASTS rather than unspecified 'stacks'.
